name: Keto Calculator Plugin
author: The Right Software

sections.description:
The Keto Calculator plugin, developed by The Right Software, is a user-friendly tool for calculating dietary needs on a ketogenic diet. Designed to help users achieve various goals such as healing, weight loss, and performance improvement, this plugin allows easy input of personal data to generate a customized keto diet plan. Simply use the [keto_calculator] shortcode to embed the calculator on any page.

For more information on WordPress plugin development, visit The Right Software’s Plugin Development Services page. Explore our other WordPress Plugins, or contact us at hello@therightsw.com. Please include your WordPress and WooCommerce versions.

Features:

Supports both Metric and US Customary units for input.
Displays calculated results in both tabular and graphical formats.
Offers diet plans for weight loss or weight gain, tailored to user goals.
Easily embed the calculator on any WordPress page using the [keto_calculator] shortcode.
Future Updates:

Customization options for table and graph styles
Options for customizing result text
PDF report generation for user results

Support

Visit The Right Software for further details and inquiries about the Keto Calculator plugin.
sections.installation:
Upload the ketocalculator folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
Activate the plugin via the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
Add the [keto_calculator] shortcode wherever you wish to display the Keto Calculator.
